name: Marcellinus' Dalmatia
alt: Dalmatia under Marcellinus and Julius Nepos

predecessors.name: Western Roman Empire
predecessors.text: Dalmatia: Marcellinus 'ruled over the region of Dalmatia', where his fleet was 'based at Salona'; Nepos 'ruled Dalmatia from Salona, the provincial capital'

successors.name: Western Roman Empire
successors.text: Dalmatia, joined to the Western Empire when Julius Nepos was proclaimed western Augustus on 24 June 474; he fled back to Salona on 28 August 475

rulers.name: Marcellinus
rulers.title: comes rei militaris, later magister militum and patrician

ledger.x: 454: Marcellinus rebels against Valentinian III and holds Dalmatia.
468: Marcellinus is murdered and his nephew Julius Nepos inherits Dalmatia.
24 June 474: Nepos, ruler of Dalmatia, deposes Glycerius and is proclaimed western Augustus in Rome, so Dalmatia ceases to be separate from the Western Empire.

wars.name: Marcellinus's campaigns against the Vandals (Sicily and Sardinia)
wars.outcome: 'In 464 or 465 Marcellinus returned to Sicily to defend the island against the Vandals'; by 468 he had 'expelled the Vandals from Sicily' and 'retaken Sardinia'; he 'never sailed for Africa' in the 468 campaign and was murdered in Sicily that year.

certainty.note: The pages name the region, not a frontier.
